future: Richer sources may land later. v1 only ships this file — no scraping of vendor docs.
notes: Categories are the stable map. Brand names are examples as of asOf, not endorsements and not a forever list.

categories.name: Chat
categories.goodFor: Explaining an idea, outlining a plan, rewriting a paragraph, asking what an error means, practicing prompts.
categories.notGoodFor: Editing the files in your real project by itself. You will copy and paste. That is fine in week one.

categories.name: IDE agent
categories.job: Edit the project in front of you
categories.goodFor: Changing files you can see, showing a diff, working in the same window as your code.
categories.notGoodFor: Blindly accepting a huge rewrite you have not read.
examples: other editors with a built-in agent

categories.name: Terminal agent
categories.job: Run commands where you already work
categories.goodFor: People comfortable in a terminal who want the AI to run tests, inspect files, and propose git commands.
categories.notGoodFor: Week one if the terminal still feels like a dark room. You can come back to this.

categories.name: Image
categories.goodFor: A rough logo, a layout sketch, a diagram of how the pieces connect.
categories.notGoodFor: Producing the actual app. Use the picture as a reference, then build in chat or an editor.
